extension.rangeNavigator.highlight.backg: Specifies the background color used to highlight the line selected after clicking on a search result in the sidebar.
extension.rangeNavigator.highlight.borde: Specifies the border color used to highlight the line selected after clicking on a search result in the sidebar.
extension.rangeNavigator.history.maxSize: Maximum number of search histories to save
extension.rangeNavigator.autoShowSidebar: Automatically shows the sidebar and performs a search whenever text is selected in the editor
